_comment: Tier-2 for dune::poisson#5 and dune::poisson_mms#5 — the same two grid objects answer both, so one fixture. Measured on dune-fem 2.12.0.2, 2026-08-06, wall time 2 s (no scheme is built, so nothing JIT-compiles): structuredGrid([0,0],[1,1],[4,4]) -> 16 cells, all 'quadrilateral'; aluConformGrid(cartesianDomain([0,0],[1,1],[4,4])) -> 32 cells, all 'triangle'; P1 dof count 25 on BOTH, which is why the dof count cannot be used to tell the grids apart and the element count can. 3D structuredGrid([0,0,0],[1,1,1],[4,4,4]) -> 64 'hexahedron' cells with lagrange order 1 -> 125 dofs and order 2 -> 729 dofs, i.e. exactly (n*k+1)^3, the identity the poisson_mms cubic-cost cap is derived from. MUTATION CONTROL (2026-08-07): T2_MUTATE=1 builds the 2D grid under test with aluConformGrid on the same cartesianDomain, so the grid really is simplicial. Unmutated the fixture still PASSES; mutated it FAILS because the expectations 'structured_2d_cells=16', "structured_2d_types=['quadrilateral']", 'dune_structuredgrid_cell_shapes_verified=True' are no longer printed and the forbidden token 'FAIL:' appears. Re-verify with `cd <fixture dir> && T2_MUTATE=1 ~/miniconda3/envs/dune-fem-env/bin/python source.py` (the mutation branch lives in source.py, so the proof is one command and needs no external harness). ENVIRONMENT: there is no ofa-dune conda env on this host, which is the interpreter scripts/run_tier2_fixtures.py falls back to; dune-fem 2.12.0.2 lives in ~/miniconda3/envs/dune-fem-env. Without DUNE_PYTHON set to that interpreter the runner records this fixture as `skipped`, not `failed`, so a summary that counts only passes and failures shows nothing wrong while nothing was executed. Every measurement quoted above, and the mutation verdict, was taken with DUNE_PYTHON=~/miniconda3/envs/dune-fem-env/bin/python.
